# Application Configuration
# Generated from template on %Y-%3-%28 %21:%9:%455

[application]
name = MyApplication
version = 1.0.0
debug = false

[server]
host = localhost
port = 8080

[logging]
level = info
file = /var/log/myapplication.log

# Environment-specific settings

[production]
performance_mode = true

state.templateContent:
# Systemd Service Configuration for {{ service_name }}

[Unit]
Description={{ service_name | capitalize }} Application
After=network.target
Wants=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User={{ service_user }}
Group={{ service_group }}
WorkingDirectory=/opt/{{ service_name }}
ExecStart=/opt/{{ service_name }}/bin/{{ service_name }}
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

# Environment variables
Environment=LOG_LEVEL={{ log_level }}
Environment=MAX_CONNECTIONS={{ max_connections }}

# Security settings
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/{{ service_name }}/logs
ReadWritePaths=/var/log/{{ service_name }}

# Resource limits
LimitNOFILE=65536
LimitNPROC=4096

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Myapp Application
After=network.target
Wants=network.target

[Service]

Restart=always

# Environment variables

# Security settings

PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true

LimitNPROC=4096
